solutionSql:
SELECT customer_id,
       id,
       CAST(SUM(weight_kg) OVER (
         PARTITION BY customer_id
         ORDER BY booked_at, id
         ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
       ) AS integer) AS running_kg
FROM shipments
WHERE weight_kg IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY customer_id, booked_at, id;
notes: Revised text states integer for running_kg. The window SUM of integers is bigint, so it is cast to integer; values unchanged (sample customer 1: 1412, 3398, 4825). Frame is ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING to CURRENT ROW, ordered by booked_at, id; the unique id makes the order total. Shipments with NULL weight are excluded before the window.
